jobs.title: Case Manager - Pomona Women's Center
jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.

This is a union-eligible position.

The required shift for this position is:
Tues. - Saturday 7:30am-4:30pm plus a late day Wednesday 11-8pm

Job Summary

HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.

Prototypes is one of the nation’s leading behavioral healthcare providers and is a “prototype” for such organizations. Prototypes Women's Center in Pomona is a 180-bed residential facility tailored specifically to women, including those who wish to involve their children in their journey to recovery. Our program aims to assist women in maintaining their progress in overcoming co-occurring disorders through a wide range of supportive services. Children can foster a secure attachment with their mothers in a secure setting, while also accessing mental health support and educational assistance. Our interdisciplinary team of professionals provides comprehensive treatment for substance use disorders and mental health, parenting, educational, and life skills courses. Treatment can range from 60 days to 6 months.

The Case Manager I provides in-person support to clients by coordinating care both within HealthRIGHT 360 and with outside service providers. They work closely with clients to complete intake paperwork, conduct outcome assessments, and apply for benefits. As part of a multidisciplinary team, the Case Manager I helps ensure effective treatment that aligns with HealthRIGHT 360’s mission, values, and policies. Services are delivered flexibly in outpatient offices, residential facilities, or in the community, depending on client needs and program requirements. Therefore, reliable transportation is required.

Key Responsibilities

Direct Service

Assist the client with intake by completing case management assessment and entering financial and benefit information.
Support the client in applying for Medi-Cal or transferring Medi-Cal County when appropriate.
Assess the client’s case management needs and complete all releases of information.
Connect the client to benefits, mental health, physical health, employment, probation, DCFS, housing, community resources, outpatient substance use disorder services, and aftercare.
Coordinate communication and external service linkage including assisting with scheduling appointments, communicating with probation, scheduling child visits, communicating with DCFS, obtaining all court minute orders, providing appointment reminders for therapy and psychiatrist.
Deliver services in outpatient, residential, or field depending on assignments and client need.
Complete the VI-SPDAT and connect the client to safe housing options.
Prepare the client for job search by assisting with resume writing and job search preparation.
Monitor client's progress toward achieving case management treatment plan goals and provide treatment plan input.
Seek clinical consultation throughout the treatment episode and when encountering new and/or high-risk clinical circumstances.
Work collaboratively with other members of the treatment team including the Clinical Therapist, Counselor, Medical, and Psychiatrist.
Communicate collaboratively with all members of the behavioral health team including medical, mental health, psychiatry, substance use disorder, and other staff.
Transport clients as needed.
Complete client UA tests and document test results.

Documentation

Write and complete all progress notes within 72 hours of service delivery.
Maintain compliance with the due dates for all clinical documentation.
Write client’s progress letters and court reports and obtain final approval from the supervisor.
Complete all documentation in compliance with agency policy and procedures, HIPAA, 42-CFR, DMH, and SAPC standards.
Complete all assigned URC’s within a timely manner.

Administration And Other Duties

Assist with client program oversight by managing case management business passes.
Meet expected client care hours (productivity expectation is 25 client care hours per week).
Maintain full compliance with requirements for registration or certification.
Attend and actively participate in assigned Clinical Group Supervision.
Actively participate in agency and team meetings.
Participate in training opportunities and complete all assigned training in a timely manner.
Arrange work schedule in accordance with the agency’s needs.
Read emails daily and respond when appropriate.

And perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Education, Certification, Licensure, and Experience

Option I:
High school diploma or equivalent.
Substance Use Disorder Counselor registration from an accredited California agency (CCAPP, CAADE, CADTP).

Option III:
Bachelor’s degree in Social Work, Psychology, or other related field from an accredited institution.

Case management experience.
Experience working with clients experiencing acute withdrawal from substances.
Experience in the human service field and demonstrated expertise in substance abuse treatment, relapse prevention, and recovery.
Valid First Aid and CPR certification or ability to obtain within 30 days of hire.
Valid California Driver’s License and access to registered and insured transportation.

Competencies

Assessment Skills. Ability to conduct thorough case management assessments, including intake procedures and outcome measures.
Care Coordination. Ability to navigate internal and external resources to support clients’ treatment plans. Ensure smooth transitions between services to maintain continuity of care.
Communication Skills. Effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate external service linkage, maintain client communication, and collaborate with various stakeholders.
Community Knowledge. Familiarity with local community behavioral health and public health systems to make proper referrals.
Cultural Sensitivity. Ability to interface well with diverse, disadvantaged populations including those with history of incarceration, substance use, or mental health issues while withholding judgment.
Data Management. Ability to enter client records accurately and maintain client records in electronic databases.
Field Readiness. Comfortable working in a variety of settings based on client and program needs.
Integrity and Ethics. Adherence to confidentiality laws, ethical guidelines, and organizational policies, and demonstrate accountability, reliability, and integrity in all actions.
Teamwork. Accountable to the team and positively collaborate with other team members and community-based providers.
Technical Skills. Ability to use electronic health records (EHR) and other tools for case management.
Bilingual preferred.

Background Check And Other Requirements

Qualified candidates with a criminal record will be considered for employment.
Must be capable of obtaining and maintaining a satisfactory background check.
Must be capable of meeting health screening and tuberculosis testing requirements.
Must be capable of meeting program and funding requirements.
Must be capable of maintaining credential requirements, if applicable.

NG Space Systems is looking for a Manager, Program Level 3, to provide leadership to the Program Management organization for the Propulsion portfolio supporting the Mission Enabling Products (MEP) Business Unit in the fast-growing Intelligence Systems Division (ISD) in Commerce, California.

This position is 100% On-Site

(MEP) is a leading designer, producer, and supplier of spacecraft components that power and enable satellites of all classes. Products include spacecraft panels, bus structures, precision optical structures, deployable structural systems and mechanisms, solar arrays, antenna reflectors and propulsion tanks. Our products are on virtually every U.S. satellite built in the last 20 years.

Learn more about Mission Enabling Products at our website: https://www.northropgrumman.com/space/spacecraft-components

Overview

The selected candidate will report to the Propulsion Product Director and serve as a key member of the leadership team for the evolving Propulsion portfolio. The candidate selected will be involved in program execution, cost, schedule, staffing, team building, customer satisfaction, ensuring compliance with organizational processes and procedures, maintaining relationships with and providing status to program leadership and customers. The individual will lead a matrixed-functional team aligned to common program performance goals from inception of an idea through program completion.

As a program manager, the primary objective will be the delivery of all contractual requirements on cost and schedule, while achieving all technical objectives and creating customer intimacy to support value creation strategies and actions. Program Managers are responsible for leading all phases of the program life cycle from inception (proposal development) through startup, execution, and completion (contract closeout). The individual will lead a cross-functional organization aligned to common program performance goals.

The candidate will be responsible for technical leadership and functional management of the Propulsion Program Managers. The candidate must be able to effectively communicate complex concepts, have a successful track record of program performance, and possess interpersonal team building skills. The selected candidate for this position must work full-time, on-site at the Northrop Grumman Commerce, CA site.

Besides functional responsibilities, primary program responsibilities are the management of cost, schedule, and technical performance of company programs and include, but are not limited to, the following:

Set vision, lead, and manage an ~8-person team of program managers
Functional management of Program Manager team (time reporting, performance reviews, statement of work, performance evaluations, employee development, mentoring efforts, engagements, and other functional tasks)
Demonstrate a commitment to ethics and integrity, and the capability to innovate while challenging traditional ways of doing business
Interface directly with the Customer, Business Management, Contracts, Engineering, and other functional/support teams in support of program objectives, technical integrity, customer expectations, and schedule
Develop and implement team structures, organizational framework, and processes to optimize productivity and foster a high-performing, cohesive, and collaborative team environment
Developing new business opportunities through long term strategic planning, capture planning, and development of proposals and business plans
Identify, allocate, and manage program resources, including workforce planning
Adhere to all internal processes, policies, and applicable industry standards
Manage proposals, negotiation of contracts, contract changes, specifications, operating budgets, schedule milestones, and key terms and conditions
Cultivate customer relationships and intimacy to develop further opportunities within the customer community
Establish a program organization that effectively addresses customer requirements and incorporates the necessary internal and external sub-organizations
Establish design concepts, criteria, and engineering efforts for product research, development, and integration and test
Conduct thorough risk & opportunity management
Lead and direct cross-functional Integrated Program Teams (IPT) to meet program cost, schedule and technical performance objectives
Ensure the program team understands and adheres to contract scope, and implements changes through a control board
Measure and report program performance to internal and external customers
Deliver clear and compelling presentations to customers, executive management and other program stakeholders
Develop and adhere to budget baselines utilizing Earned Value Management (EVM) or similar cost & schedule control methodologies and tools
Manage customer supplied property or information (GFE, CFE, etc.)

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree and 10 years, or master’s degree and 8 years’ experience U.S. Government contracts and customers and/or project management in the Aerospace Industry
Minimum 5 years’ of experience with functional and/or technical leadership experience
US Citizenship is a requirement for employment
Experience leading the performance of program tasks on schedule, at cost, and achieving all requirements as either a program manager, project lead, integrated program team (IPT), or cost account manager (CAM)
Experience building and leading diverse and inclusive teams with high levels of engagement, including mentoring, coaching, and conflict resolution
Advanced MS Office Suite and MS Project skills

Preferred Qualifications

Passion and relentless drive to achieve results, exceptional leadership skills, effective and timely decision-making, negotiation skills, and problem-solving skills
Knowledge and experience with implementation and execution of process standards focused on program execution, business development, and risk management
Experience establishing organizational and execution methods using program management tools such as Earned Value Management System (EVMS), Integrated Master Plan (IMP), Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), and Risk and Opportunity Management
An effective collaborator who can develop and maintain good working relationships with internal and external stakeholders
Proven track record of developing product strategy and developing stakeholder/customer relationships, pursuit capture, and shaping requirements
Experience in Program Management, Engineering and Manufacturing, and/or IPT roles
Broad skill set that is balanced between interpersonal, business, and technical capabilities
Strong organization skills in both independent and team environments
Effective communicator (verbal and written) with proven experience with developing and briefing presentations
Ability to adjust communication to an audience (from manufacturing technician up through customer and executive management)

Primary Level Salary Range: $193,000.00 - $289,600.00

jobs.description:
About The Role

Airports and venues are Uber's highest-stakes customer experience moments. Airports alone account for approximately 15% of Uber's Mobility Gross Bookings globally - a disproportionate share driven by our premium portfolio, high-value riders, and the structural complexity of airport operations across 100+ priority hubs worldwide. On a platform completing more than 40 million trips every day, airport journeys punch well above their weight: they disproportionately shape how business travelers, tourists, and premium users perceive Uber. A single poor experience at a priority hub doesn't just generate a support ticket; it drives churn among the cohort most likely to be first-trip riders, most likely to upgrade to premium products, and most likely to become long-term brand advocates.

The Airports & Venues CX program owns the global strategy to eliminate that friction at scale. We sit at the intersection of Ops, Product, and CX - translating on-the-ground airport complexity (staging lots, regulatory constraints, fare structures, matching algorithms, wayfinding failures) into systemic, data-driven solutions that reduce defects across the top 100+ priority airports worldwide including venues.

As Program Manager, Airports & Venues CX
, you will own the global defect reduction program - the most consequential initiative within this domain. You are the person who understands what is driving each basis point of airport defect rates across key issues such as fare disputes, cancellations, lost items or transaction issues at our priority hubs, and builds the cross-functional machine that surfaces customer insights, quantifies root causes drives and advocates for product and on ground improvements to bring that number down - structurally, not episodically.

This role is ideal for a senior CX, support operations, product operations, or travel operations leader who combines analytical rigor, customer empathy, AI fluency, and deep comfort operating in complex physical environments such as airports, airlines, mobility platforms, hospitality, logistics, or large-scale venues.

In the face of complex technical and operational challenges with no established playbooks to follow, we act with thoughtful urgency, driving conversations, discussions, and outcomes. Experience driving large programs with a holistic understanding of business-wide functions (ie. Product, Eng, Legal, External Engagement, etc) and the ability to manage deliverables between organizations
Strong leadership skills to manage both upstream and downstream dependencies.
Clear verbal and written communication, alongside the ability to navigate ambiguity and drive decision-making in a fast-paced environment

Job Summary

HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.

Prototypes is one of the nation’s leading behavioral healthcare providers and is a “prototype” for such organizations. Prototypes Women's Center in Pomona is a 180-bed residential facility tailored specifically to women, including those who wish to involve their children in their journey to recovery. Our program aims to assist women in maintaining their progress in overcoming co-occurring disorders through a wide range of supportive services. Children can foster a secure attachment with their mothers in a secure setting, while also accessing mental health support and educational assistance. Our interdisciplinary team of professionals provides comprehensive treatment for substance use disorders and mental health, parenting, educational, and life skills courses. Treatment can range from 60 days to 6 months.

As part of a multidisciplinary team, the Case Manager I helps ensure effective treatment that aligns with HealthRIGHT 360’s mission, values, and policies.
